speech.p: That all words after "whilst" be omitted with a view to substituting the following words: "declining to give the bill a second reading, the House also notes that: (1) many small retailers still lack the technical systems needed to comply with the proposed timeframe; (2) consumers should be given a longer transition period before new data-sharing obligations take effect; and (3) the bill, in its current form, would place additional compliance costs on regional businesses without a corresponding support package".
The question now is that the amendment moved by the honourable member for Fairview be agreed to.
